steps.command:
cd ~/benchmarks/xsbench.noindex/corpora && f=large-text/$(ls large-text | head -1) && echo "== $(hostname) $(nproc 2>/dev/null || sysctl -n hw.ncpu) cores, file $f" && for t in 1 8; do echo "-- zstd levels 1..3, $t thread(s)"; zstd -b1 -e3 -i3 -T$t "$f" 2>&1 | tr "" "
" | grep -E "^ *[0-9-]+#" | tail -3; for n in 1 5 20; do zstd --fast=$n -b -i3 -T$t "$f" 2>&1 | tr "" "
" | grep -E "#" | tail -1; done; done; echo "-- lz4 level 1, 1 thread"; lz4 -b1 -i3 "$f" 2>&1 | tr "" "
" | grep -E "#" | tail -1

cd ~/benchmarks/xsyncv4/lab/corpora && f=large-text/$(ls large-text | head -1) && echo "== $(hostname) $(nproc 2>/dev/null || sysctl -n hw.ncpu) cores, file $f" && for t in 1 8; do echo "-- zstd levels 1..3, $t thread(s)"; zstd -b1 -e3 -i3 -T$t "$f" 2>&1 | tr "" "
" | grep -E "^ *[0-9-]+#" | tail -3; for n in 1 5 20; do zstd --fast=$n -b -i3 -T$t "$f" 2>&1 | tr "" "
" | grep -E "#" | tail -1; done; done; echo "-- lz4 level 1, 1 thread"; lz4 -b1 -i3 "$f" 2>&1 | tr "" "
" | grep -E "#" | tail -1
